digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent clone and event store
propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot clone at HEAD = refs/remotes/origin/tickets before A6-0b final receipt
The first file is an unsigned derived TICKET_DIGEST cache superseded by a newer committed digest for the same ticket and is disposable cache residue
The second file is an expired and superseded CLAIM_ENRICH event with lease expiry predating inspection time and a later authoritative claim and DONE event
Both files must be removed only if their SHA-256 hashes match recorded evidence, git status contains exactly those paths, and HEAD equals refs/remotes/origin/tickets, with abort on any mismatch

After authorized disposal, the persistent clone must have no untracked event files, empty git status, no merge/rebase/stash state, and HEAD equal to refs/remotes/origin/tickets before A6-1 publication
